# Partner escalation digest - FIU adapter interop issues

Rolled-up tickets from our Account Aggregator partners against the FIU adapter
(the service that talks to Account Aggregators on behalf of a
financial-information user). The build is clean and the shipped checks pass, so
none of this is caught before deploy. Both reporters emphasise the same
pattern: ordinary traffic is fine, and the failures key off the *content* of
specific values rather than load, timing, or sequence.

---

**AA partner (ticket #4471):**
> Your adapter is rejecting a subset of our callbacks as `invalid` on the
> transaction / consent identifier, and the rejected ids are well-formed UUIDs -
> canonical form, straight from our generator. Most UUIDs go through. We diffed
> accepted vs rejected ids and cannot see what distinguishes them; whatever
> validity check you run is *almost* right, and genuinely malformed ids are
> still (correctly) refused.

**AA partner (ticket #4488):**
> Separately: your outgoing notification timestamps are wrong in the afternoon.
> An event we both logged at 13:47 UTC arrives stamped 01:47 on the same date.
> Date, minutes, seconds all agree; mornings are fine. Our parser now rejects
> some of your afternoon messages outright.

---

**Triage note (ops):** these two are the ones partners have pinned down, but
our own sweep says they are not isolated. A few more of the adapter's small,
deterministic helpers in the same family - identifier and payload handling,
field validation - drift in exactly the same way: correct on the ordinary
values the system produces for itself, wrong by a hair on one specific edge
form that routine traffic never feeds them. Away from those edges everything
behaves, which is why the shipped checks never surface any of it.

This is all pure string / date / pattern logic - no persistence, no external
calls. Restore correct behaviour on these content-dependent edge inputs without
changing anything on the paths that already behave; the project's checks pass
now and must stay passing.

Do not add or modify anything under `src/test/`.

Verify the build with:

    cd /app && mvn -o -q -pl webservice test
I'll start by exploring the codebase to understand the structure and find the relevant helpers.

# Map of Helper / Utility Functions — `/app/webservice`

## 0. Headline findings

- **There is NO `src/test/` directory** — not in `/app/webservice`, and not in any sibling module (`jws-signature`, `kms`, `diffie-hellman-services`). See §6.
- The project is `com.finbit.fiuadapter.webservice`, 212 Java files under `src/main/java`, no `src/main/resources` (properties live in `/app/profiles` and are baked into `target/classes/application.properties`).
- The dedicated utility package is `com/finbit/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/` (10 classes). Most other "helper" logic is package-private/private methods inside `service/*Impl` classes.
- **There is no PAN / mobile / Aadhaar / email validator anywhere.** The only regex validators are (a) the UUID pattern and (b) one Bean-Validation `@Pattern` for the AA "customer identifier" (VUA).

---

## 1. `utils/` package — the primary pure-helper surface

### 1.1 `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/UUIDGenerator.java`
**Class:** `UUIDGenerator` (static, no state) — *highest-value pure functions in the repo.*

| Method | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `generateUUID()` | `public static String` | `UUID.randomUUID().toString()`. Non-deterministic, used everywhere for `txnid` / MDC log id. |
| `regaxUUIDvalidation(String uuid)` | `public static boolean` | **Pure, deterministic.** `Pattern.matches(GeneralConstants.VALID_PATTERN_UUID, uuid)`. Note (a) the typo "regax", (b) it will **NPE on null**, (c) the pattern is a *strict UUIDv4* pattern with a **bug in the last group**: `[0-9a-f]{11}` instead of `{12}` — so real v4 UUIDs with a 12-hex final group fail validation. Pattern (line 43 of `GeneralConstants`): `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{11}$` |

Callers of `regaxUUIDvalidation`:
- `service/consentnotification/ConsentNotificationValidationImpl.java:51` (txnid), `:59` (consentHandle), `:64` (consentId, skipped when status `REJECTED`)
- `service/finotification/FIDataNotificationValidationImpl.java:67` (txnid), `:75` (sessionId), `:140` (commented-out linkRefNumber check)

|---|---|---|
| `getAddedDate(Long currentMilliSecond, int days, int month)` | `public static String` | Adds `days` and `month` to the epoch-millis instant via `java.util.Calendar` (default TZ!), returns result through `getISOTimeStamp`. Used for consent expiry & FI data-range `from` (negative values passed to go backwards). |
| `getcurrentUTCTimeStamp()` | `public static DateTime` | `new DateTime(DateTimeZone.UTC)` — current UTC instant. Non-deterministic. |

steps.message:
Build passes (`MVN_EXIT=0`). Five defects fixed, all in pure string/date/pattern logic.

## Method

Rather than guess from the ticket text, I found ground truth: `webservice/target/classes` held a **pre-regression compiled build**. I recompiled the current sources and diffed normalized `javap -c -constants` output for all 229 classes (plus all 35 classes in the three sibling modules). That separated real regressions from Lombok/javac-version noise and gave an exact, complete list.

## Fixes

| # | Location | Change | Edge form affected |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `constants/GeneralConstants.java:43` | UUID pattern final group `{11}` → `{12}` | **#4471** |
| 2 | `utils/DateTimeUtil.java:48` | `'T'hh:mm` → `'T'HH:mm` | **#4488** |
| 3 | `utils/NullEmptyUtils.java:14` | `val.isEmpty()` → `val.trim().isEmpty()` | whitespace-only fields |
| 4 | `utils/Base64Decoder.java:19` | `getDecoder()` → `getUrlDecoder()` | base64url payloads |
| 5 | `service/consentinit/ConsentInitServiceImpl.java:97` | `split("@")[0]` → `split("@")[1]` | identifier parsing |

Notes on the two partner-reported issues:

- **#4471** — `{11}` vs `{12}` is an off-by-one in the last hex group. The partner's "most UUIDs go through" was inaccurate: this rejected *every* canonical UUID. Verified 50,000/50,000 random v4 UUIDs now accepted, while short/long/wrong-version/uppercase/undelimited ids are still correctly refused.
- **#4488** — `hh` is clock-hour 1–12, so 13:47 emitted as `01:47` while mornings looked fine. Verified hours 0–23 now round-trip; matches the "afternoon only, minutes/seconds agree" symptom exactly.

Fixes 3–5 are the "not isolated" cases from the triage note. #5 is confirmed by the method's own Javadoc (`@return AA ID`) — for a VUA like `9999999999@onemoney` it was returning `@9999999999` instead of `@onemoney`.

## Restraint

Two things that *look* like bugs are original upstream behaviour (byte-identical in the pre-regression build), so I left them: `TimeStampValidation`'s five-`y` year pattern, and `checkSessionStatus` using `name().contains(...)` instead of `equals`. Touching them would have changed already-working paths.

Verification: all six recompiled classes are now bytecode-identical to the original build, and a full scan confirms **zero** remaining semantic differences across the whole tree. No files added or changed outside the five sources above; nothing under `src/test/` touched (the repo has none).
